reason: The v7 bundle lifted pixelate8 AUC from 0.7229 to 0.8322, which is still the weakest known variant. p=0.15 was fixed in advance in v7 and never varied, and one seed per member leaves the size of seed noise on pixelate8 unknown.
reference: v7 bundle: v7_resnet50 + v7_cnxt_small + v7_swin_t, equal mean_logit, orig+flip
recipe: exactly the v7 recipe per member (12 epochs, EMA 0.99, backbone_lr_mult 1.0, label smoothing 0.05, aug strong, conflict drop, bs 64, lr 1e-3 resnet50, 3e-4 convnext_small and swin_t). Only --mosaic_p and --seed change.

candidates.seeds6: v7 trio + trio p15_s7, six members

noise_reference: pixelate8 of the three p=0.15 trios (v7, p15_s7, p15_s123), three members fused by robust_eval. These two extra trios are not candidates alone.

common_required: clean AUC point gain >= -0.002 and 95% CI lower bound > -0.006 vs v7 (default suite, ensemble_pool, paired bootstrap 1000, seed 0)
worst-of-23 AUC point gain >= -0.002 and 95% CI lower bound > -0.006 (same)
no extended variant other than clean and pixelate8 falls by more than 0.005 vs v7
T4 estimate under 200 s, confirmed on a T4 before shipping
switch_rule.route_a_pixelate: pixelate8 gain >= +0.02 vs v7 and pixelate8 above the best of the three p=0.15 trios
switch_rule.route_b_general: clean and worst-of-23 point gains both >= +0.004 with both 95% CI lower bounds > 0
switch_rule.pass: all common checks and at least one route
switch_rule.several_pass: take the highest mean AUC over the default-suite and extended-suite variants

stress_suite: robust_eval --suite stress on the reference and each trio: reporting only, not part of the rule. pixelate12 and pixelate5 lie inside the trained block range, pixelate24 outside it.
limits: pixelate8 lies inside the trained block-size range. Four candidates on one validation fold, so the winner's gain is optimistic.
rerun_policy: rerun only for a crash, OOM or a run that did not learn. Candidates are scored once.
never: test images in any statistic or training
